purpose: What pictures show, as vectors in one space with texts (user 2026-11-10: sorting the B-roll by content, offline), as a plug-in program beside the application. The AI catalog of the host names the program, the model and how many pictures a usable part is looked at (1-3); nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

pictures.ok: { vectors: [[number]] }: one unit vector a picture, in the order given

texts.ok: { vectors: [[number]], scale, bias }: one unit vector a text; a text describes a picture by the sigmoid of cosine * scale + bias

rules: At most 32 pictures or texts a request. The pictures are JPEG files in an empty temporary folder of the application; the plug-in reads them and the model and writes nothing. A picture it cannot read is an error, never a guess.
acceptance: crates/qnc-siglip/examples/look.rs (what one picture shows) and crates/qnc-shot-content-run/examples/look_card.rs (the shot analysis and the content of one original, only read).
